resources.string: Test build %1$s. Some things described here are not in this build yet.
%1$s is the program that keeps this phone simple.
%1$s are equals: either can add apps with you.
%1$s helps choose which apps are on it, together with you, with the phone in %1$s\'s hands. \"For %1$s\" needs %1$s\'s PIN so that nobody else can change your phone.

%2$s can\'t read your messages, see where you are, or see what you do in your apps. %1$s has no server of its own, no analytics and no account. It connects to %3$s\'s computer over home Wi-Fi only to update itself.

%1$s sends %2$s a text only when you choose to ask for an app or share a link, when the monthly check is due, when %1$s needs a check or a phone update is coming, when %2$s\'s PIN is used to change something on this phone, when a big change (like turning %1$s off) starts, is cancelled or finishes, or if %2$s\'s PIN is typed wrongly many times (so %2$s knows if someone is guessing it).
The phone keeps a list of changes from the last 90 days. It doesn\'t include your messages, websites or what you do in apps.
Tap Phone, type 9-1-1, and press call.
From the lock screen, tap Emergency call.
